name: Baugsmidr Dwarf
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision to a range of 120 feet.

Arcane Lore.

You have Advantage|XPHB on Intelligence (Arcana) checks.

Dwarven Resilience.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Poison damage. You also have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

Magical Crafter.

You have Advantage|XPHB on any checks made to create magical items.

Sense Magic.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can sense the presence of magic within 120 feet until the end of your next turn. You see a faint aura around any visible magic object or active spell, and you know its school of magic. You also detect the presence and location of otherworldly creatures, such as Aberrations, Celestials, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. This ability can be blocked by 1 foot of solid material, such as stone or metal. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Bearfolk
traitsHtml:
Apex Predator.

When you make a Charisma check, you can add your Strength or Constitution modifier to it (choose which during character creation). You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Wild Heart.

You and allied creatures within 5 feet of you have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws against the Frightened condition while you are conscious and do not have the Incapacitated condition.

Thick Coat.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Cold damage and Immunity|XPHB to the effects of extreme cold.

Bearfolk Lineage.

You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a legacy from the Bearfolk Lineages table. You gain a different benefit depending on your choice: Andari or Garhamr.

name: Beastkin
traitsHtml:
Animal Instinct.

You have proficiency in either the Perception or Survival skill (your choice).

Natural Weapons.

You have claws, horns, hooves, fangs, spines, or a similar adaptation that serves as a natural weapon. Work with your GM to determine what type of natural weapon you possess and decide whether it deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage. You can use your natural weapon to make Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier damage (choose which during character creation) of your chosen type, instead of the damage normal for an unarmed strike.

Natural Adaptation.

You inherit one of the following traits determined by what kind of animal characteristics you want your character to have.

Avian.

Leathery, feathery, or gossamer wings sprout from your back or connect to your outstretched arms. You have a Fly Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB. You can't fly while wearing Medium or Heavy armor.

Agile.

Sharp claws, cloven hooves, robust limbs, reversed joints, or suction pads on your hands and feet allow you to scrabble up trees, rock faces, and uneven surfaces with ease. You have a Climb Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB. In addition, you have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws made to avoid having the Prone condition.

Aquatic.

Oily fur, scales, fins, webbed hands and feet, or long, gangly limbs are common for your people. You have a Swim Speed|XPHB equal to your Speed|XPHB. You can hold your breath for up to 20 minutes.

Sturdy.

Powerful limbs, fat reserves, or a thick hide allow you to endure harm and accomplish feats of remarkable athleticism. When you aren't wearing armor, you have an AC of 13 + your Dexterity modifier. In addition, you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can drag, lift, or push.

name: Elf
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Elven Lineage.

You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven lineages Table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown in the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability score when you select the lineage).

LineageLevel 1Level 3Level 5
Alfar (Hidden Elf)You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. In addition, you have Advantage|XPHB on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in forests.Silent ImageBlur
Ice ElfYou know the Ray of Frost cantrip. In addition, you have Advantage|XPHB on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in icy or snowy conditions.Ice KnifeGust of Wind
Fey Ancestry.

You have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

Keen Senses.

You have proficiency in your choice of two of the following skills: Insight, Perception, and Survival.

Trance.

You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest|XPHB in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trance-like meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

name: Giantkin
traitsHtml:
Catch and Throw.

If you are hit by a ranged weapon attack, you can use your Reaction|XPHB to add 3 to your AC. If that causes the attack to miss, you can catch the missile, provided the attack included a projectile or was a small thrown weapon (GM's discretion), and throw it back at the attacker, using your normal ranged weapon attack bonus and the weapon's normal damage.

Powerful Build.

You have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws that you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

Giantkin Ancestry.

Your ancestry grants you supernatural abilities. Choose an ancestry from the Giantkin Ancestry table. You gain a natural resistance to the effects of certain natural environments or a condition, and a trait indicated by your chosen ancestry.

If a benefit grants you the ability to cast a spell, you always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

If a benefit of your ancestry requires a saving throw, the DC is 8 + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose at character creation) + your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus.

AncestryNatural ResistanceBenefit
CloudYou have Immunity|XPHB to the effects of Extreme Cold and high altitude.
FireYou have Immunity|XPHB to the effects of Extreme Heat.
FrostYou have Immunity|XPHB to the effects of extreme cold and Advantage|XPHB on saves against the Stunned condition.
HillYou have Advantage|XPHB on saves against the Poisoned and Stunned conditions.
StoneYou have Advantage|XPHB on saves against the Prone and Petrified conditions.
StormYou have Advantage|XPHB on saves against Lightning damage. You have Immunity|XPHB to the effects of high altitude.

entries.name: Airstep
entries: You can cast {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB} at will (self only)

entries.name: Windcall
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can cause the air within 30 feet of you to move in a direction of your choice. This can push one Medium or smaller creature up to 5 feet away from you, move an unattended object up to 10 feet, or create a harmless sensory effect using air, such as slamming a door.

rows: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of {@hazard Extreme Heat|XDMG}.

entries.name: Burning Blood
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you take Piercing or Slashing damage, a creature you choose within 5 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} Fire damage. You can use this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
This damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach character levels 5, 11, and 17.

rows: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of extreme cold and {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves against the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Iceshaper
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you can choose an area of ice, snow, or water within 30 feet of you that fits into a 1-foot cube. You can move it up to 5 feet (in a direction of your choice), cause it to form into simple shapes, or freeze/unfreeze it, provided there are no creatures in it. After 1 hour, or if you use this ability again, the material reverts to its previous state.

entries.name: Snowsight
entries: You can see through areas obscured by snowfall, sleet, and other wintry precipitation without penalty. You also have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to snow-blindness.

rows: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves against the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Bulky
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves vs. the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, and if you succeed on such a save, you can push the creature initiating the grapple 10 feet.

entries.name: Iron Stomach
entries: You can ingest nearly any organic matter, treating 2 pounds of matter as equal to a day's worth of rations.

rows: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves against the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Petrified|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Stonepulse
entries: Your ability to feel tremors in the ground gives you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls if you and all your foes are touching solid ground.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You also have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

rows: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves against Lightning damage. You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the effects of high altitude.

entries.name: Crackling Personality
entries: While in an area open to the sky, you can cast {@spell Levitate|XPHB} (self only) at will.

entries.name: Stormsight
entries: You can see through areas obscured by clouds, fog, rain, and storms without penalty. You also have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to snow-blindness.

description:
**Catch and Throw**: If you are hit by a ranged weapon attack, you can use your Reaction|XPHB to add 3 to your AC. If that causes the attack to miss, you can catch the missile, provided the attack included a projectile or was a small thrown weapon (GM's discretion), and throw it back at the attacker, using your normal ranged weapon attack bonus and the weapon's normal damage.

**Powerful Build**: You have Advantage|XPHB on saving throws that you make to end the Grappled condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

**Giantkin Ancestry**: Your ancestry grants you supernatural abilities. Choose an ancestry from the Giantkin Ancestry table. You gain a natural resistance to the effects of certain natural environments or a condition, and a trait indicated by your chosen ancestry.

If a benefit grants you the ability to cast a spell, you always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

If a benefit of your ancestry requires a saving throw, the DC is 8 + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose at character creation) + your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus.

name: Trollkin
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

Natural Weapon.

You have fangs, hooves, or claws, which serve as a natural weapon. Work with your GM to determine what type of natural weapon you possess and decide whether it deals Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage. You can use your natural weapon to make Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with it, you deal 1d6 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier damage (choose which during character creation) of your chosen type, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed attack.

Trollish Regeneration.

The regenerative power in your blood allows you to quickly recover from wounds. As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can expend any number of Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice up to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus to regain Hit Points|XPHB. If you take Acid or Fire damage, you lose access to this ability until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB.

Natural Adaptation.

You manifest different traits depending on your non-humanoid ancestor. Choose one of the ancestor types from the Trollkin Ancestry table. You gain a different benefit depending on your choice.

AncestryBenefit
FeyWhen you make an ability check that uses Charisma, you may roll a 1d6 and add it to the total. You can use this trait a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.
OgreYou have Advantage|XPHB on ability checks and saves to avoid or escape grapples. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.
TrollYou have Advantage|XPHB on saves against the Stunned condition. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

name: Werekin
traitsHtml:
Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

Claws.

You have wickedly sharp claws that you can use to make Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes. When you hit with your claws, you deal 1d6 + your Strength modifier Slashing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

Predatory Prowess.

You have proficiency in the Athletics, Intimidation, Perception, or Survival skill (your choice).

Scent.

You have Advantage|XPHB on Wisdom (Perception) checks relating to detecting scents and tracking.

Shift Aspect.

You can transform as a Bonus Action|XPHB, gaining the primal power of your lycanthropic forebears. The transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it (no action required). Once you transform, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

When you transform, you gain one of the following options (choose the option each time you transform).

  • Bestial Strength.

    You gain Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to twice your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus. You also have Advantage|XPHB on Strength checks as well as any checks or saves to resist or end the Grappled condition.

  • Primal Savagery.

    You channel the raw savagery of your bestial side. When you use this option, and as a Bonus Action|XPHB on each of your turns while it is active, you can roar. Creatures other than your allies within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn. A creature that succeeds on the save has Immunity|XPHB to your roar for 24 hours.

  • Swift Hunter.

    Your body becomes primed for the hunt. Until the transformation ends, your Speed|XPHB is increased by 10 feet, and you have Advantage|XPHB on Strength (Athletics) and Wisdom (Survival) checks.
